title: FishingSpots
description: Plugin that adds cool spots to fish
body:
# FishingSpots

Find special fishing spots in the world that can reward you with cool loot.

## Features

- Fishing spots that spawn in the world
- Fun mini-game to catch rewards
- Loot with rarities and chances
- Particles and messages customization
- Commands and permissions
- Free support

## Commands & Permissions

- `/fishingspots createitem <id>` — Create a loot item  
  Permission: `fishingspots.admin.createItem`

- `/fishingspots reload` — Reload plugin  
  Permission: `fishingspots.admin.reload`

- `/fishingspots spawnspot [rarity]` — Spawn a fishing spot  
  Permission: `fishingspots.admin.spawnSpot`

- `/fishingspots` — Show plugin version  
  Permission: `fishingspots.version`

## Animations

To configure an animation you need to define a **transition**. Transitions use a **cubic-bezier** function (same format as CSS).

Each animation frame contains **parameters** of 3 types:

- `circle`
- `line`
- `point`

Use the `l` parameter for **line length** and **circle radius**.

Some particles require additional data (Item / BlockData / Color). Provide it via:

- `data`
- `r`, `g`, `b`
